descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT OAT-02 step 1 · “Confirm every network request in the app uses HTTPS, no plain HTTP endpoint anywhere.”.

Approach · OAT-02 Encryption Verification · S05 Release transport settings per platform: web bundle, iOS, Android

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Every network request the app makes (web, iOS and Android, in Hospital and Nursing Home) uses HTTPS. There is no plain-HTTP endpoint anywhere. (UAT OAT-02; UAT 4; TFA-92568 AC 4; TFA-92568 Eng 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given The release artefacts of the UAT build: the production web bundle, the iOS archive's Info.plist and the Android release APK (merged manifest and network security config)

When Read the Convex URLs baked into each and its transport-security settings

Then Web: VITE_CONVEX_URL and VITE_CONVEX_SITE_URL are https://. iOS: no NSAllowsArbitraryLoads and no per-domain cleartext exception. Android release: usesCleartextTraffic=false, and the debug config (localhost, 127.0.0.1, 172.20.10.6) is not merged.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-02 step 1 'no plain HTTP endpoint anywhere'. A baked-in http:// endpoint (XML namespace URIs excluded), or a release setting that allows cleartext to a non-local host, = Fail. NSAllowsLocalNetworking is judged per Q6.

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: code-review.

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress)

Android main manifest: usesCleartextTraffic="false" (line 12); network security config only in src/debug (cleartext domains localhost, 127.0.0.1, 172.20.10.6), merged into debug builds only. capacitor.config.ts: server.url not set, cleartext false, androidScheme https.

Still needs (needs): release artefacts (deployed web bundle, IPA Info.plist, release APK merged manifest) — the deployed web bundle waits for dev sign-in; IPA/APK need Tim (CI)
